an5.40:1.1: “Bhikkhus, based on the Himalayas, the king of mountains, great sal trees grow in five ways.
an5.40:1.3: (1) They grow in branches, leaves, and foliage;
an5.40:1.8: Based on the Himalayas, the king of mountains, great sal trees grow in these five ways.
an5.40:1.9: “So too, when the head of the family is endowed with faith, the people in the family who depend on him grow in five ways.
an5.40:1.16: When the head of a family is endowed with faith, the people in the family who depend on him grow in these five ways.”
an5.40:2.1: Just as the trees that grow in dependence on a rocky mountain
an5.40:3.1: so, when the head of a family here
an5.40:3.4: his wife, children, and relatives all grow in dependence on him;
an5.40:3.5: so too his companions, his family circle,
an5.40:4.1: Those possessed of discernment, seeing that virtuous man’s good conduct,
an5.40:5.1: Having lived here in accord with Dhamma,
an5.40:5.2: the path leading to a good destination,
an5.40:5.4: those who desire sensual pleasures rejoice, delighting in the deva world.
